description: The department head and governor discuss a declaration at the first briefing and when an offer remains open.

slots.disaster: The incident named in the emergency offer.
slots.deadline: The day the emergency offer expires.

parts.text: The people getting ready for the {disaster} will hear from me as soon as you've signed.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: If I'm asked why you declared for the {disaster}, I'll send that question to your office.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll announce the declaration for the {disaster} and leave the reasons for you to give.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: The county offices will get a way to reach you when they get the news about the {disaster}.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll give the local directors your contact information on the call about the {disaster}.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: You'll get the questions about declaring for the {disaster}. I can answer for the department.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll make sure reporters covering the {disaster} know you're taking questions yourself.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll ask public health to brief you on what the {disaster} means for the next few days.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Once the declaration for the {disaster} is signed, I'll get the health director on the phone for you.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll take the declaration back so the counties have your decision on the {disaster} in writing.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: The counties can work from the signed order for the {disaster}. I'll get it to them.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll get the papers for the {disaster} moving while we still have time.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: That gives us until {deadline} to get the request in. I'll take the signed declaration with me.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Here's the declaration for the {disaster}. I'll stay until you've signed.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll put the order for the {disaster} in front of you and take it back when you're done.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll get a county director on the line here while you sign the order for the {disaster}.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll make the calls from this room. When you've signed, I'll tell the counties the declaration for the {disaster} is in effect.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll tell them you signed before {deadline} and that your office will take questions.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: When people call about the declaration for the {disaster}, I'll give them your office number.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll pass your invitation along to the people who advised us about the {disaster}.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Anyone who wants to follow up on the advice about the {disaster} can call you after the signing. I'll tell them.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: The next forecast for the {disaster} will come straight to you.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll bring the new forecast for the {disaster} even though the declaration will already be signed.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: Here it is. I'll take the signed declaration for the {disaster} back to the department.
parts.author: Codex writer A

parts.text: I'll wait for the signature before I leave with the order for the {disaster}.
parts.author: Codex writer A
